verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a managed scraping API, and products of this kind could plausibly expose browsers to Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium or Scrapy, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows its own Scrape/Crawl API, its own TS/Python SDKs, and built-in click/wait/scroll actions. None of it documents compatibility with or connection from those open-source automation libraries.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build scrapers using popular open-source automation libraries like Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or Scrapy
